findings.evidence: Check secrets, generated artifacts, lockfile churn mixed with unrelated logic, and scope accuracy against current paths.
findings.fix: Ground the generic parts: check staged paths against .gitignore and the build outputs the CI config produces; keep lockfile-churn and scope-accuracy, the checks the model actually skips.

findings.evidence: 1. Establish which changes are approved for this task. Inspect status, staged diff, and working-tree diff; treat pre-existing index content as user-owned unless explicitly included. If unrelated staged content exists, stop and request authorization for an index-isolation strategy. Never proceed with an ordinary commit that would include unrelated staged content.
findings.fix: Split into 1a inspect, 1b ownership rule, 1c stop rule; one 60-word step hides the stop condition an agent must not miss.

findings.evidence: Never commit an unresolved merge: conflict markers can produce a syntactically valid but semantically partial result.
findings.fix: Extend to the rebase case: during a rebase git status shows 'rebasing' and a commit silently continues it; check status in step 1, not just for conflict markers.

findings.evidence: stop and request authorization for an index-isolation strategy
findings.fix: Name the default tactic after authorization (e.g., stash unrelated staged content with git stash push --keep-index, or build the commit from a temporary index); 'an index-isolation strategy' leaves the fragile step to invention.

findings.evidence: 3 output evals, no evals/files/ fixtures; prompts describe git state in prose only.
findings.fix: Add evals/files fixtures (a status/diff snapshot with mixed staged and unstaged content) so selective-staging assertions grade real command sequences.

findings.evidence: The main skill defines the required Conventional Commit shape.
findings.fix: SKILL.md step 6 never states the shape; add the minimal template there (type(scope)!: subject, blank line, body, footer) or move the shape into this reference so the cross-reference resolves.
